name: rwxLabs Research
description: Research on grants data, governance, ecosystems and CROPS for Ethereum institutions. Machine-readable catalog; every item links to a human page and to raw markdown.
publisher: rwxLabs (Sun Flora Collective OPC Pvt. Ltd.)
license: CC BY 4.0 unless stated otherwise on the item

golem.name: Golem Foundation
golem.about: Runs Octant, which directs staking rewards to public goods through community allocation.
golem.need: Measuring and comparing yield-funded public goods allocation; privacy-aware funding data.

ethlabs.name: Ethlabs
ethlabs.about: Independent non-profit R&D lab for Ethereum and ETH, founded in 2026 by former Ethereum Foundation researchers.
ethlabs.need: CROPS stewardship, ecosystem evaluation methods, and machine-readable research.

ethereum-institutional.name: Ethereum Institutional
ethereum-institutional.about: Independent non-profit (launched July 2026) acting as the institutional front door to Ethereum: education, institutional intelligence, standards and best practices, events.
ethereum-institutional.need: Institutional intelligence built on sourceable data; standards for reporting ecosystem spending; governance due diligence.

ef-enterprise.name: Ethereum Foundation · Enterprise (institutions.ethereum.org, Enterprise Onchain)
ef-enterprise.about: The EF's institutional portal and Enterprise Acceleration work, with the Enterprise Onchain newsletter.
ef-enterprise.need: Evidence for the institutional case, regional chapters such as India, and CROPS framed for institutions.

eea.name: Enterprise Ethereum Alliance
eea.about: Member organization that coordinates enterprises and defines standards for institutional Ethereum.
eea.need: Open metadata standards (EIP-4824, DAOIP-5) for funding disclosure and governance discovery.
